t: Generate and use AWS-account-based endpoints for compatible services when the account ID is available. At launch, DynamoDB is the first and only compatible service. The new endpoint URL pattern will be ``https://<account-id>.ddb.<region>.amazonaws.com``. Additional services may be added in the future. See the documentation for details: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/sdkref/latest/guide/feature-account-endpoints.html
Include params set in provide-client-param event handlers in dynamic context params for endpoint resolution.
Fix cache implementation to reduce memory consumption.
Resolve endpoint with default partition when no region is set
Migrate all services to use new AWS Endpoint Resolution framework
Discontinued use of `sslCommonName` hosts as detailed in 1.27.0 (see `#2705 <https://github.com/boto/botocore/issues/2705>`__ for more info)
Implemented new endpoint ruleset system to dynamically derive endpoints and settings for services
Improved endpoint resolution for clients with unknown regions
